Class InMemoryCatalog

java.lang.Object
edu.cssd2101.lab02.InMemoryCatalog
All Implemented Interfaces:
MaterialCatalog
public final class InMemoryCatalog extends Object implements MaterialCatalog
One LinkedHashMap owns ordering and uniqueness; expected O(1) ID operations, O(n) snapshots.
